{{Quote|Some local Ragtags keep messing with me and my work. That's partly why I agreed to a relocation to another planet, but I'd still like to stick it to those Ragtags.|[[Strilath Farles]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TMHP4" />}}
The '''Ragtag Base''' was a bunker operated by the [[Ragtags|Ragtag]] criminals on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Located in the [[Nomad Mountains]], the base was inhabited by [[Gramo Murah]] and his band of Ragtag goons. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Murah's goons entered into a violent conflict with another criminal organization, the [[Meatlumps]],<ref name="SWG:TMHP4" /> fanatical anti-technology thugs.<ref name="Meatlumps">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67782&month=052008|text=Friday Feature &ndash; Meatlumps!}}</ref> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the ''[[Corellia Times]]'' [[Journalist/Legends|reporter]] [[Vani Korr]] tasked a spacer to deal with the Meatlump lieutenant [[Strilath Farles]] in exchange for information about the Meatlumps. Farles wanted his revenge on the Ragtags who humiliated him and the adventurer accepted to rid him of Gramo Murah and his gang. The spacer attacked the Ragtag bunker and finally killed Gramo Murah and some of the Ragtag goons. The spacer also destroyed their stash of stolen goods.<ref name="SWG:TMHP4" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ragtag Base was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TMHP4" /> prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Ragtag Base was added to the game with the update dubbed "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 10|Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King]]," released on [[June 19]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67812&month=062008|text=Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King}}</ref>
